title: Maya Bazaar
desc: A businessman dearly loves his daughter and wants to ensure that she is always protected. Meanwhile, his close friend and business partner hatches a plot to usurp his wealth.

title: Senathipathi
desc: Sethupathi, a young man, falls in love with Lingappan Naicker, the village head's daughter Aishwarya. Meanwhile, the girl's father asks Senathipathi, Sethu's older brother, to protect her.

title: Album
desc: Jeevan's father helps Annachi after she is cheated by his brother. He soon becomes the object of affection of Annachi's daughter, but he turns her down to pursue other goals in life.

title: Idhu Namma Aalu
desc: A lower-caste man marries a girl of a higher caste by hiding his true social background.
